Record every change under "Unreleased" in CHANGELOG.md.
files.money.py:
def split_amount(cents, parts):
    """Splits an amount in cents into shares that add up to the total.

    Left-over cents are given one each to the first shares.
    Raises ValueError when parts is below 1.
    """
    if parts < 1:
        raise ValueError("parts must be at least 1")
    base, extra = divmod(cents, parts)
    return [base + 1 if i < extra else base for i in range(parts)]

            shares = split_amount(total, parts)
            assert len(shares) == parts
